paragraphs.zh: 地点：山路旁的旧军碑
paragraphs.en: Location: An old military stone beside a mountain road

paragraphs.zh: 人物：一名守夜人
paragraphs.en: People: A solitary watcher

paragraphs.zh: 起因：碑上的姓名已被风雨磨去
paragraphs.en: Situation: Rain has almost erased the names on the stone

paragraphs.zh: 守夜人想重新记下死者的名字。碑后不时传来低语；靠近的人说，自己看见了藏在树影中的身影。
paragraphs.en: The watcher wants to preserve the names of the dead. Whispers come from behind the stone; those who listen report seeing figures hidden in the shadows.

requirements.zh: 条件：至少拥有一座城市；至少80金币，选择后支付。
requirements.en: Requires: at least one city; at least 80 Gold, paid on selection.

requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队生命大于20；探索部队不是镜仪侦测队或无声司镜；未拥已拥有镜瞳训练/洞察术/封印感应。
requirements.en: Requires: explorer health above 20; not Mirror Detection Team or Silent Mirror Keeper; does not have Mirror-Eye Training, Insight, Seal Detection.

paragraphs.zh: 地点：山坡上的废弃观测台
paragraphs.en: Location: An abandoned hillside observatory

paragraphs.zh: 人物：探索队的施法者和记录员
paragraphs.en: People: Your casters and record keepers

paragraphs.zh: 起因：一面破镜仍能映出肉眼看不到的东西
paragraphs.en: Situation: A broken mirror still reveals things invisible to the eye

paragraphs.zh: 施法者可以尝试使用镜子，但碎裂的镜面并不安全。也可以整理旁边的笔记，或卖掉还能使用的残片。
paragraphs.en: A caster could try to use the mirror, though its cracked surface is dangerous. The nearby notes can be studied, or the remaining pieces sold.

requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队为术士或施法英雄；探索部队生命大于25；未拥已拥有镜瞳训练。
requirements.en: Requires: an elemental mage or spellcasting hero; explorer health above 25; does not have Mirror-Eye Training.

paragraphs.zh: 地点：林边一座荒废的园圃
paragraphs.en: Location: An overgrown garden at the forest edge

paragraphs.zh: 人物：队中的医护和斥候
paragraphs.en: People: Your healers and scouts

paragraphs.zh: 起因：封住园门的树根仍然活着
paragraphs.en: Situation: Living roots still bar the garden gate

paragraphs.zh: 根下埋着旧刻板。队伍可以冒险查看；熟悉生息法术的人还可以尝试照料这些根系。
paragraphs.en: Old tablets lie beneath the roots. Examining them is risky. Someone trained in life magic might instead try to care for the roots.

requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队生命大于20。
条件：已拥有生命调息；未拥已拥有泉林契约；探索部队生命大于20。
requirements.en: Requires: has Breath of Life; does not have Springwood Covenant; explorer health above 20.

paragraphs.zh: 地点：近水的废弃码头
paragraphs.en: Location: A ruined landing near the water

paragraphs.zh: 人物：几名探路的队员
paragraphs.en: People: Members of your expedition

paragraphs.zh: 起因：石匣里藏着一张渡水图
paragraphs.en: Situation: A stone box holds a chart of water crossings

paragraphs.zh: 图上标着浅滩和暗流。派人试走路线能积累经验，但也可能受伤；抄录航图则更稳妥。
paragraphs.en: The chart marks shallows and dangerous currents. Testing the route could teach the expedition useful skills, at some risk. Copying the chart is safer.

requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队生命大于20；未拥已拥有海陆转运。
requirements.en: Requires: explorer health above 20; does not have Amphibious Transport.

paragraphs.zh: 地点：荒废的古路驿站
paragraphs.en: Location: An abandoned road station

paragraphs.zh: 人物：负责探路和补给的队员
paragraphs.en: People: Your pathfinders and supply crew

paragraphs.zh: 起因：旧驿册记下了附近的废墟、营地和水源
paragraphs.en: Situation: A register describes ruins, camps and water sources nearby

paragraphs.zh: 有些路标还在。队伍可以挑一条路线复查，也可以把整册带回去整理。
paragraphs.en: Some of its road markers remain. Follow a route to check it, or take the register home for study.

requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队尚未满生命。

paragraphs.zh: 地点：一处倒塌的营地
paragraphs.en: Location: A collapsed camp

paragraphs.zh: 人物：发现木匣的队员
paragraphs.en: People: The soldiers who found a wooden chest

paragraphs.zh: 起因：木匣里有旧器物、记录和少量药品
paragraphs.en: Situation: The chest contains old equipment, notes and medicine

paragraphs.zh: 器物的用法还辨认得出，记录也值得保存。受伤的队员则希望先拿药品来用。
paragraphs.en: The equipment can still teach useful techniques, and the notes are worth preserving. Wounded soldiers would rather use the medicine.

requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队尚未满生命。

paragraphs.zh: 地点：林间通往泉水的小路
paragraphs.en: Location: A woodland path leading to a spring

paragraphs.zh: 人物：一名背药箱的旅医
paragraphs.en: People: A traveling physician with a medicine chest

paragraphs.zh: 起因：旅医留下的药料已不够继续赶路
paragraphs.en: Situation: The physician lacks supplies for the road ahead

paragraphs.zh: 他愿意随队行医，但需要你提供补给。若不邀请他，也可以交换一些急用药，或记下沿路的救护地点。
paragraphs.en: He is willing to join your expedition if you fund his supplies. Otherwise, you can obtain some medicine or record the shelters along his route.

requirements.zh: 条件：至少拥有一座城市；现有访世者少于2位；未招募泉路医师；探索部队生命大于20；至少160金币，选择后支付。
requirements.en: Requires: at least one city; fewer than two visiting heroes; Springroad Physician is not already recruited; explorer health above 20; at least 160 Gold, paid on selection.

requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队尚未满生命。

paragraphs.zh: 地点：山坡上的断碑旁
paragraphs.en: Location: A broken stone on a hillside

paragraphs.zh: 人物：一名披甲幽魂
paragraphs.en: People: An armored specter

paragraphs.zh: 起因：幽魂一直守着阵亡者的名册
paragraphs.en: Situation: The specter watches over a list of fallen soldiers

paragraphs.zh: 他希望有人把名册带到安全的地方。若你愿意安排住处和补给，他也愿意随军同行。
paragraphs.en: He asks you to take the names somewhere safe. With shelter and supplies arranged, he is willing to join your army.

requirements.zh: 条件：至少拥有一座城市；现有访世者少于2位；未招募碑誓行者；至少240金币，选择后支付。
requirements.en: Requires: at least one city; fewer than two visiting heroes; Monument Oathwalker is not already recruited; at least 240 Gold, paid on selection.

paragraphs.zh: 地点：山地废炉旁
paragraphs.en: Location: Beside a ruined mountain forge

paragraphs.zh: 人物：熔印使者
paragraphs.en: People: The visitor known as the Molten Sigil Envoy

paragraphs.zh: 起因：铸师还守着几件未完成的器具
paragraphs.en: Situation: The smith still tends several unfinished tools

paragraphs.zh: 他想继续研究魔晶，也愿意帮助你的军队。邀请他需要准备补给；若只抄下炉边的笔记，也能有所收获。
paragraphs.en: He wants to continue studying magic crystals and offers to help your army. Recruiting him requires supplies; copying his notes is another useful option.

requirements.zh: 条件：至少拥有一座城市；现有访世者少于2位；未招募熔印使者；至少有1份可用魔晶；至少320金币，选择后支付。
requirements.en: Requires: at least one city; fewer than two visiting heroes; Molten Seal Envoy is not already recruited; at least one available Magic Crystal; at least 320 Gold, paid on selection.

paragraphs.zh: 地点：高地上的破镜台
paragraphs.en: Location: A damaged mirror station on high ground

paragraphs.zh: 人物：一名沉默的司镜
paragraphs.en: People: A quiet mirror keeper

paragraphs.zh: 起因：镜架已经倾斜，司镜却不肯离开
paragraphs.en: Situation: The frame is failing, but its keeper refuses to leave

paragraphs.zh: 他请队员帮忙修好镜架。完成这项危险的工作后，他愿意与你们同行；也可以只保存台上的测量记录。
paragraphs.en: He asks your expedition to repair the frame. After this dangerous work, he is willing to travel with you. You could instead preserve the measurements.

requirements.zh: 条件：至少拥有一座城市；现有访世者少于2位；未招募无声司镜；探索部队生命大于25；至少160金币，选择后支付。
requirements.en: Requires: at least one city; fewer than two visiting heroes; Silent Mirror Keeper is not already recruited; explorer health above 25; at least 160 Gold, paid on selection.

paragraphs.zh: 地点：林间的小祭坛
paragraphs.en: Location: A small shrine in the woods

paragraphs.zh: 人物：明灯誓卫和几名伤者
paragraphs.en: People: The Lantern Oathguard and several wounded travelers

paragraphs.zh: 起因：誓卫一直在照料路上遇见的人
paragraphs.en: Situation: The guard has been caring for travelers along the road

paragraphs.zh: 他愿意随军保护伤者，但需要补给和安置。若不邀请他，也可以把这些救护办法记下来。
paragraphs.en: He offers to protect the wounded in your army if you arrange supplies and shelter. You could instead record his methods.

requirements.zh: 条件：至少拥有一座城市；现有访世者少于2位；未招募明灯誓卫；本局已启用宗教；至少240金币，选择后支付。
requirements.en: Requires: at least one city; fewer than two visiting heroes; Lantern Oathguard is not already recruited; religion enabled; at least 240 Gold, paid on selection.

paragraphs.zh: 地点：古路旁的废弃驿舍
paragraphs.en: Location: A ruined inn beside an old road

paragraphs.zh: 人物：一名护商人
paragraphs.en: People: An experienced caravan guard

paragraphs.zh: 起因：商队离开后，护商人仍留在这里守路
paragraphs.en: Situation: The guard stayed behind after the caravan departed

paragraphs.zh: 他熟悉这段道路，也愿意随队保护补给。邀请他需要一笔安置费；若只问清路线，也能把见闻保存下来。
paragraphs.en: He knows the road and offers to protect your supplies. Recruiting him requires funds. You could instead record what he knows about the route.

requirements.zh: 条件：至少拥有一座城市；现有访世者少于2位；未招募护商仲裁者；至少400金币，选择后支付。
requirements.en: Requires: at least one city; fewer than two visiting heroes; Caravan Arbiter is not already recruited; at least 400 Gold, paid on selection.

RU01.zh: 遗存钱币：从废墟中回收古币，获得[]金币。
RU01.en: Ancient coins: Recovered [] Gold from the ruins.

RU02.zh: 旧歌残卷：整理出先民歌谣，获得[]文化。
RU02.en: Old songs: Recovered ancestral songs and gained [] Culture.

RU03.zh: 失落计算：复原一段计算方法，获得[]科研。
RU03.en: Lost calculations: Reconstructed a method and gained [] Science.

RU04.zh: 流亡农户：接纳幸存农户，一座本方城市人口增加1。
RU04.en: Refugee farmers: One of your cities gains 1 population.

RU05.zh: 古路草图：发现一幅残缺地图，揭示附近一部分未知地形。
RU05.en: Old road sketch: A damaged map reveals part of the surrounding terrain.

RU06.zh: 祭祀铭文：解读先民祷辞，获得[]信仰。
RU06.en: Ritual inscriptions: Deciphered an ancient prayer and gained [] Faith.

RU08.zh: 先民训练：探索部队研习旧战术，获得10经验。
RU08.en: Ancestral training: The exploring unit gains 10 XP.

RU09.zh: 废墟医药：探索部队使用旧药，恢复最多30生命，不超过最大生命。
RU09.en: Ruin medicines: The explorer recovers up to 30 HP, capped at full health.

RU10.zh: 安魂记述：保存亡者的故事，获得[]文化。
RU10.en: Repose records: Preserved stories of the dead and gained [] Culture.

RU11.zh: 前线线索：发现警戒记录，揭示8格范围内的荒野营地位置。
RU11.en: Frontier clues: Revealed barbarian camps within an 8-tile radius.

RU13.zh: 术式校验台：探索术士获得晶壁契约，可按单位动作说明施展护身晶壁。
RU13.en: Calibration table: The exploring mage gains the Crystal Ward Covenant; see its unit action for use.

RU14.zh: 回生盟碑：探索部队获得泉林契约，取得该晋升记载的恢复能力。
RU14.en: Restoration oathstone: The explorer gains the Springwood Covenant and its healing benefits.

RU15.zh: 遗民向导：一支巡林斥候加入本方，仍需正常维护。
RU15.en: Survivor guide: A Forest Scout joins your civilization and requires normal upkeep.

RU16.zh: 古路坐标：发现完整测绘坐标，揭示探索部队周围5格内的地图，不取得领土。
RU16.en: Old road coordinates: Revealed terrain within 5 tiles of the explorer, without claiming land.

RU17.zh: 遗产箱：找到保存完好的旧钱，获得[]金币。
RU17.en: Inheritance chest: Recovered preserved coins and gained [] Gold.

RU18.zh: 探索发现：誓碑下的守夜人。请在遭遇窗口阅读背景，并选择处理方式；奖励取决于你的选择。
RU18.en: Discovery: Watchers Beneath the Oathstone. Read the encounter and choose a response; the outcome depends on your decision.

RU19.zh: 探索发现：星历盲镜。请在遭遇窗口阅读背景，并选择处理方式；奖励取决于你的选择。
RU19.en: Discovery: The Blind Star Mirror. Read the encounter and choose a response; the outcome depends on your decision.

RU20.zh: 探索发现：根庭封圃。请在遭遇窗口阅读背景，并选择处理方式；奖励取决于你的选择。
RU20.en: Discovery: The Old Root Covenant. Read the encounter and choose a response; the outcome depends on your decision.

RU21.zh: 探索发现：沉钟航图。请在遭遇窗口阅读背景，并选择处理方式；奖励取决于你的选择。
RU21.en: Discovery: The Sunken Bell Chart. Read the encounter and choose a response; the outcome depends on your decision.

RU22.zh: 探索发现：失传驿册。请在遭遇窗口阅读背景，并选择处理方式；奖励取决于你的选择。
RU22.en: Discovery: The Lost Courier Register. Read the encounter and choose a response; the outcome depends on your decision.

RU23.zh: 探索发现：无主人的封缄匣。请在遭遇窗口阅读背景，并选择处理方式；奖励取决于你的选择。
RU23.en: Discovery: The Sealed Relic Casket. Read the encounter and choose a response; the outcome depends on your decision.

RU24.zh: 探索发现：泉路上的最后一担。请在遭遇窗口阅读背景，并选择处理方式；奖励取决于你的选择。
RU24.en: Discovery: The Last Load on Springroad. Read the encounter and choose a response; the outcome depends on your decision.

RU25.zh: 探索发现：静镜值守。请在遭遇窗口阅读背景，并选择处理方式；奖励取决于你的选择。
RU25.en: Discovery: The Silent Mirror Watch. Read the encounter and choose a response; the outcome depends on your decision.

RU26.zh: 探索发现：刻名者的条件。请在遭遇窗口选择如何处理。
RU26.en: Discovery: Watcher at the Broken Stone. Read the encounter and choose a response.

RU27.zh: 探索发现：熔印不会替你选目标。请在遭遇窗口选择如何处理。
RU27.en: Discovery: Visitor at the Old Forge. Read the encounter and choose a response.

RU28.zh: 探索发现：林间灯火。请在遭遇窗口选择如何处理。
RU28.en: Discovery: Lanterns in the Grove. Read the encounter and choose a response.

RU29.zh: 探索发现：驿道护卫。请在遭遇窗口选择如何处理。
RU29.en: Discovery: Guards by the Old Road. Read the encounter and choose a response.
